artifacts.label: Ochre Handprint
artifacts.story: A handprint made for someone who had not yet arrived.

artifacts.label: Ivory Sky Pendant
artifacts.story: Its spiral matches the dormant portals.

artifacts.label: Keeper's Ember Vessel
artifacts.story: The clan kept one flame alive for generations.

artifacts.label: First Flint Spearhead
artifacts.story: A tool became an heirloom when survival became memory.

artifacts.label: Ritual Stone Shard
artifacts.story: The carved figure resembles the traveler.

artifacts.label: Tablet of the First Flood
artifacts.story: The river record mentions a stranger arriving through light.

artifacts.label: Reed Sun Charm
artifacts.story: A household charm offered to the settlement's absent founder.

artifacts.label: Royal Grain Seal
artifacts.story: Proof that scarcity had become abundance.

artifacts.label: Scribe's Traveling Palette
artifacts.story: Its hidden inscription is written in the traveler's hand.

artifacts.label: Eye of the River Temple
artifacts.story: It was made to watch over every age at once.

artifacts.label: Foundation Coin
artifacts.story: Buried beneath the village on the day it began.

artifacts.label: Miller's Wind Token
artifacts.story: The scratched date should not exist in this calendar.

artifacts.label: Guildmaster's Hammer
artifacts.story: Its maker claimed the design came to him in a dream.

artifacts.label: Silver Town Seal
artifacts.story: The traveler's silhouette stands at the seal's center.

artifacts.label: Chronicle of the Empty Museum
artifacts.story: A history of a building that will not exist for centuries.

artifacts.label: First Martian Water Sample
artifacts.story: Its container bears the museum inventory number 001.

artifacts.label: First Oxygen Membrane
artifacts.story: The material remembers an atmosphere it never touched.

artifacts.label: Red Algae Culture
artifacts.story: The first life cultivated on a second world.

artifacts.label: Prototype Fabricator Core
artifacts.story: Its blueprint contains a component from the portal.

artifacts.label: Message From Deep Space
artifacts.story: The message is addressed to the traveler by name.

story.title: The Empty Hall
story.text: You remember cataloguing this object before. The museum was not abandoned when you found it; you were here when it closed.

story.title: A Deliberate Silence
story.text: A recording bears your voice: 'If I forget, let the civilizations choose what returns.' You erased the collection yourself.

story.title: The First Intervention
story.text: You once tried to perfect every age. Each correction created another fracture. The people in the portals remember different versions of you.

story.title: The Other Traveler
story.text: Someone traveled beside you. Every surviving record has removed their face, but not their shadow.

story.title: Curator of Possible Worlds
story.text: The museum never preserved one true history. It preserved the worlds people built after being given a choice. You returned to finish that promise.
